Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity Android phone SCREEN ONLY for Story App, a Chinese personal offline TXT novel reader. Single flat straight-on artboard 1024x2176, edge-to-edge UI, no device bezel, no perspective, no desktop page, no background outside screen, no presentation labels. Practical implementable Material 3 inspired custom styling: calm contemporary editorial, warm paper #F6F2E8, near white panels #FFFCF7, ink #292E2A, secondary #646B61, one muted pine green accent #355A4B. Chinese system sans serif UI, exceptionally crisp legible Simplified Chinese exact labels, clear 4/8dp spacing, 24dp horizontal gutters, standard consistent thin outline icons, 48dp touch boxes. No gradients, grain, blurred glass, ornate ornaments or huge shadows. Status bar at top 9:41 with Android signal and battery; unobtrusive Android gesture indicator bottom. Do not add search, bookmarks, favorites, statistics, avatars, account, subscription, ads, online catalog, play duration/time line, skip seconds, or unrequested features. This is a proposed design, not a screenshot of existing software.
Screen: personal bookshelf, calm literary identity through simple typography and composition.
At top a small understated "Story" wordmark, then generous large bold heading "书架" with trailing filled rounded button with plus icon "导入". Small line below "本地 TXT · 按最近阅读".
Four generously spaced book rows, separated by subtle rules, not rows of bulky floating cards. Each row has a locally generated typographic cover rectangle at left (no detailed illustration): a solid muted green, clay, blue-gray or ink cover, refined Chinese book title and one thin geometric rule. The covers are placeholders made from the title, not official cover art.
Row1 title "长夜行舟", author "林川", metadata "128 章 · 32.6 万字", cover same title.
Row2 title "山海来信", author "南枝", metadata "86 章 · 21.8 万字".
Row3 title "雨落旧城", author "江晚", metadata "64 章 · 16.2 万字".
Row4 title "远山微明", author "青禾", metadata "102 章 · 27.1 万字".
The title is dominant, author secondary, chapter and word counts muted but readable. Whole row is a clear tap target. No progress bars, percentages or continue-reading card because the current bookshelf has no per-book progress feed. Good screen balance; no footer navigation bar. Keep comfortable whitespace below list. Warm off-white bookshelf, sophisticated and quiet, not generic SaaS or online bookstore.

Top 24% shows the same warm paper reading page, small top bar back icon and "第一章  灯火", a few lines of readable Chinese prose. A row "语速" left and accurate current "1.45×" right, followed by compact segmented choices "0.85" "1.0" "1.15" "1.3" "1.45", selected last.

Do not turn it into a music app. Keep typography large and controls not cramped, all important labels fully visible.

Screen: reading with controls visible. Use book "山间来信" in small centered top bar with left arrow, chapter "第一章 雨后的山路" below. A refined but functional Chinese novel reader, body font normal Chinese system sans serif, same user-selectable font as current app, not ornamental calligraphy. Main content uses generous baseline rhythm but not sparse marketing whitespace. Display this prose accurately:
"雨停的时候，山谷里升起薄薄的雾。林舟推开窗，远处的松树还挂着水珠，青石路被洗得发亮。"
"他把那封信放进外套口袋，沿着熟悉的小路向村口走去。清晨的风带着草木的气息，屋檐下的燕子轻轻掠过。"
"桥边的小店刚刚开门。店主递来一杯温茶，笑着说，今天的山路应该很好走。"
"林舟点了点头，没有急着出发。他望着河面上的光，想起信里那句简单的话：有空的时候，回来看看。"
"很多年过去，山依旧在那里。改变的是路旁新长出的树，还有他终于慢下来的脚步。"
Bottom 17% is a compact single near-white control sheet with mild rounded top16dp and no heavy shadow, not a huge nest of pill-shaped containers. A chapter row has left chevron and "上一章", center "1 / 3 章", right "下一章" and chevron. Below divider, four evenly spaced simple vector-like outline icons with Chinese labels underneath, "目录", "夜间", "设置", "朗读". Only listening icon/label may be pine accented with a very subtle sage small backdrop; others dark neutral. Don't add page sliders, bookmarks or search. Comfortable Android bottom inset and gesture bar. Make controls lighter while preserving visible Chinese text and click affordance. Reading body is the focus, no dim gray veil over text.
